name: shell
title: App shell
description: Inset sidebar that collapses to icons, workspace switcher, user menu with light/dark/system theme, header with breadcrumbs and Ctrl/Cmd+K command menu, page header. Replaces app/layout.tsx with Inter + Geist Mono, ThemeProvider (system default), TooltipProvider and Toaster.

"use client" import { ChevronsUpDown, LogOut, Monitor, Moon, Sun, UserRound } from "lucide-react" import { useTheme } from "next-themes" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/ui/avatar" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu" import { SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, useSidebar } from "@/components/ui/sidebar" import { mergeLabels } from "@/lib/labels" export type NavUserLabels = { account: string theme: string light: string dark: string system: string logOut: string } export const defaultNavUserLabels: NavUserLabels = { account: "Account", theme: "Theme", light: "Light", dark: "Dark", system: "System", logOut: "Log out", } type User = { name: string; email: string } function initials(name: string) { return name .split(" ") .map((p) => p[0]) .slice(0, 2) .join("") } export function NavUser({ user, labels }: { user: User; labels?: Partial }) { const t = mergeLabels(defaultNavUserLabels, labels) const { isMobile } = useSidebar() const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme() return ( {initials(user.name)}
{user.name} {user.email}
{user.name}
{user.email}
 {t.account} {t.theme} {t.light} {t.dark} {t.system} {t.logOut} ) }
